meta.name: marketing-analytics
meta.description: Sets up, audits, and reports on marketing measurement — tracking plans, event schemas, attribution models, and the dashboards built on them. Use this to instrument a site or product, audit tracking nobody trusts, choose or interpret an attribution model, build reporting that answers a specific question, or reconcile numbers that disagree between tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可信的营销衡量与归因体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的营销数据来自多个工具,想统一衡量效果
copy.tagline_en: Set up reliable marketing measurement and attribution reporting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your marketing data sits across many tools and you need one reliable view.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会坚持先写清楚追踪方案——每个事件何时触发、带哪些参数、要回答什么问题——然后才动代码。它还能检查现有追踪数据为何不可信，说明所用归因模型的偏差，并把报表设计成回答一个明确问题。
howto.when: 当你说要给网站或产品处理追踪测量（埋点或审计）、选归因模型、做回答具体问题的报表等时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划新网站的转化事件，把事件名和属性定好。
say.note: Claude 会先问每个事件要回答什么问题，再给出命名方案。

say.text: 现在后台注册数和广告平台差很多，帮我查埋点哪里出问题了。
say.note: 他会让你实际操作并观察事件是否带参数到达。

say.text: 我该用首次触点还是最后触点归因？帮我定一下。
say.note: Claude 会说明每种模型的偏差，并建议固定一种口径。

howto.what_en: Claude insists on writing down the tracking plan (event, trigger, properties, question) before any code. It also diagnoses why existing tracking data is untrusted, states attribution-model bias, and focuses each report on one explicit question.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to instrument or audit tracking on a site/product, choose an attribution model, or build a report that answers one question, etc.

say_en.text: Plan the conversion events for my new site, with names and properties.
say_en.note: Claude will ask what question each event answers before finalizing.

say_en.text: Backend signups don't match our ad platform. Where is tracking broken?
say_en.note: You'll replay the action to see if the event arrives correctly.

say_en.text: Should I use first-touch or last-touch attribution? Help me pick.
say_en.note: Claude will explain each model's bias and keep one consistent model.
